data_contribution: No target-specific candidate/profile was exposed or adopted. All exact eye/skin geometry comes from the independent frozen baseline. The pack contributes only literal requester binding, neutral negative and embodiment/runtime audits; resulting pixels cannot be attributed to the new target enrichment.

generic_skin_candidate_review.reason: Generic dots/patches and pigment distribution add neither navel-relative carrier geometry nor the independently chosen disconnected topology.

semantic_clarification_decisions.rationale: Retain every frozen requester-owned anchor while keeping the independently authored test geometry unchanged.

The frozen direct inspection uses ordinarily open eyes and a calm closed-lip face; upward/asymmetric pupils with exposed tongue would change the independent test rather than clarify its artificial heart lens print.
This is a physically ordinary pigment and lens experiment; a broken world invariant would introduce unrelated impossible behavior.
The photograph contains no trusted counterpart, target-directed assistance or same-target helpful consequence; appearance cannot supply that relationship.
Glass belongs to the workshop background. A pane between camera and performer plus overlaid reflection would risk obscuring the two target regions.
The frontal continuous view is direct. A mirror-led face and corresponding partial body view would add an unrelated reflected carrier.
The arms rest by the performer sides and the props are transfer materials; a handheld mirror and reflected face would add a different interaction.
The face and utility top are already present, but the focal surface is skin rather than garment detail. This general portrait condition adds no target lens/marking contribution.
The declared artificial lens print is a coherent art material. A localized realism contradiction intended to produce unease would introduce another test meaning.

creative_augmentation_decisions.rationale: Retain the frontal face-and-skin hierarchy because fine pupil detail needs the existing centered frontal inspection.
A hand-supported mirror would introduce reflected-face geometry outside the chosen direct inspection.
A scanned access card supplies an unrelated duty event rather than pigment transfer.
The face reference and open-eyes observation do not justify reshaping the eye contour into a catlike ideal.
The baseline already uses diffuse overcast skylight and brass reflection. Retain that independent light without claiming this optional candidate added it.
